description: Build Simulink models that co-simulate with Eclipse SUMO traffic simulator. Use when creating SUMO-Simulink co-simulation, traffic simulation, TraCI connection, vehicle-in-the-loop testing, or ADAS scenario validation with SUMO. Also use when the user mentions SumoInterfaceLibrary, .sumocfg files, or wants to connect Simulink to an external traffic simulator.
